description: Points a domain (and, when asked, its www name) at the customer's WordPress site on YOLO Hosting, and can add the one-time TXT record that proves the customer controls the domain. It sets A, AAAA and one TXT record under _yolo-hosting only: no MX, SPF, DKIM or DMARC record is created or replaced.
variableDescription: ip: the IPv4 address of the YOLO Hosting server the site is on. ip6: that server's IPv6 address. token: the one-time code YOLO Hosting issued for this name when the customer added it to their site (24 hexadecimal characters). wwwtoken: the same for the www name. The request is signed, so these values cannot be changed on the way. Groups: ipv4 and ipv6 point the name itself; verify adds its proof record; www-ipv4, www-ipv6 and www-verify do the same for www under it and are only asked for when the template is applied at the top of the zone.
